content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To get a new york city library card, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Look up the nearest branch location (5 minutes)
Step 2. Locate your birth certificate (30 minutes)
Step 3. Search for a secondary utility bill (10 minutes)
Step 4. Print the library application form (2 minutes)
Step 5. Find a blue ink pen (1 minute)
Step 6. Double-check the signature on the back of the card (30 seconds)
Step 7. Photocopy your driver's license (5 minutes)
Step 8. Confirm the library's holiday hours (2 minutes)
Step 9. Submit the final packet to the librarian (10 minutes)
Step 10. Scan your lease agreement (10 minutes)
Step 11. Verify the address on the utility bill (5 minutes)
Step 12. Fill out the personal information section (15 minutes)
Step 13. Present all physical documents for inspection (15 minutes)
Step 14. Check the ink level in the printer (1 minute)
Step 15. Buy a packet of printer paper (1 hour)
Step 16. Organize all documents into a folder (5 minutes)
Step 17. Take a subway to the library branch (45 minutes)
Step 18. Clear a workspace on the kitchen table (10 minutes)
Step 19. Find a sturdy folder (2 minutes)
Step 20. Wait for the digital confirmation email (1 day)
Step 21. Stand in the registration line (20 minutes)
Step 22. Place birth certificate back in the safe (5 minutes)
Step 23. Receive your physical library card (2 minutes)
Step 24. Review the library's terms of service (15 minutes)
Step 25. Check for any outstanding fines from other boroughs (5 minutes)
Step 26. Log in to the library portal to set a PIN (10 minutes)
Step 27. Find your passport (1 hour)
Step 28. Borrow a stapler from a neighbor (15 minutes)
Step 29. Decide which library system to join (30 minutes)
Step 30. Bookmark the library website (1 minute)
Step 31. Ask for a branch map (2 minutes)
Step 32. Show the librarian your student ID (2 minutes)
Step 33. Find your student ID in your wallet (5 minutes)
Step 34. Check the expiration date on your ID (2 minutes)
Step 35. Provide an emergency contact number (2 minutes)
Step 36. Put on your walking shoes (3 minutes)
Step 37. Check your phone for the digital barcode (1 minute)
Step 38. Sign the physical application form (1 minute)
Step 39. Confirm your current mailing address (2 minutes)
Step 40. Wait for the librarian to enter data into the system (10 minutes)
Step 41. Power on the library computer terminal (3 minutes)
Step 42. Walk to the main circulation desk (5 minutes)
Step 43. Download the library mobile app (3 minutes)
Step 44. Locate the "New Accounts" sign (2 minutes)
Step 45. Enter the library building (1 minute)
Step 46. Ask the security guard for directions (2 minutes)
Step 47. Pick up a welcome brochure (1 minute)
Step 48. Pose for a membership photo (2 minutes)
Step 49. Clean the scanner glass (2 minutes)
Step 50. Download the PDF application (5 minutes)
Step 51. Verify your email address (2 minutes)
Step 52. Check the weather for the commute (2 minutes)
Step 53. Wait for the card to be printed (5 minutes)
Step 54. Verify the spelling on the new card (1 minute)
Step 55. Check that your phone is fully charged (5 minutes)
Step 56. Find a piece of mail with a postmark (10 minutes)
Step 57. Check the subway service status (5 minutes)
Step 58. Find a paperclip (1 minute)
Step 59. Create a library website account (10 minutes)
Step 60. Buy a transit pass (5 minutes)
